crossRefs.note: We have confidence in the Lord concerning you, that you both do and will do the things we command.
Therefore though I have all boldness in Christ to command you that which is appropriate,
Having confidence in your obedience, I write to you, knowing that you will do even beyond what I say.

translations.web: I rejoice that in everything I am confident concerning you.
translations.bsb: I rejoice that I can have complete confidence in you.
translations.kjv: I rejoice therefore that I have confidence in you in all things.
translations.asv: I rejoice that in everything I am of good courage concerning you.
